verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a changelog entry showing ClickHouse accepts HTTP requests with an X-ClickHouse-Format header. That is a raw HTTP interface, not an official driver built for short-lived serverless or edge connections. Nothing in the pack mentions WebSockets, serverless or edge runtimes, or a connection-light client library, so the HTTP interface is only an adjacent building block.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query over HTTP or WebSockets from serverless and edge functions with an official driver built for short-lived connections
